title: BIBLE 3282396: Background, and the boot sound for RIPPS2
description: **BIBLE** is akilluminati47's boot loader, built on PS2BBL by El Isra and PS2BBL Extended by saildot4k (GPL-3). Its next update is out, **every build signed by akilluminati47**, and RIPPS2 1.3.9 now installs, updates and sets it up by itself: no KELFBinder needed.
fields:
- **Background**: Auto (your RIPPS2 sky when BIBLE starts RIPPS2, black for anything else), Sky or Black (`BIBLE_BACKGROUND`)
- **The boot sound, primed**: Boot Sound On (fast) keeps `boot.adp` beside BIBLE's settings; BIBLE reads it during its splash and hands it to RIPPS2 in memory, so it plays with RIPPS2's first frame, even from an SD2PSX
- **RIPPS2 first** in BIBLE's own defaults

Settings > General > Boot Loader > **Manage** opens a BIBLE menu: **UPDATE BIBLE** binds this one over an older one, in place, and **Background, Splash, Button Glyphs, Info Line, Power-on Wait, Video Mode, Widescreen** each change one line of `SYS-CONF/PS2BBL.INI`. **EDIT BIBLE'S SETTINGS FILE** for what each button starts.

**With RIPPS2: nothing to download.** BIBLE rides inside [RIPPS2.elf v1.3.9](https://github.com/akilluminati47/RIPPS2/releases/tag/v1.3.9-beta).
**Attached here** (and on [the release page](https://github.com/akilluminati47/BIBLE/releases/tag/signed-3282396)): `BIBLE-signed-3282396.zip`, all four signed builds for other installers.

Update BIBLE with Manage on a genuine memory card, an SD2PSX or a MemCard PRO 2; PAL and Japanese consoles most of all. Tell us here or [open an issue](https://github.com/akilluminati47/RIPPS2/issues) with your console model and card.
El Isra for PS2BBL and KELFBinder, saildot4k for PS2BBL Extended.
